propPlay.writeup:
Jordin Canada has cleared 9+ points in 80% of her 49 games this season, and is riding a 7-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 11.9 points on the season (17.8 across her last 5) — the 9+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -625 at Caesars.

Chelsea Gray has cleared 7+ points in 84% of her 51 games this season, and is riding a 8-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 12.4 points on the season (16.4 across her last 5) — the 7+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -295 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
